summary.text: Joe Guthrie is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 15 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2014.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia's campaign contribution history lists general-election wins for Joe Guthrie in Rockingham 13 in 2018 and in Rockingham 15 in 2022 and 2024.
He was assigned to the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee for the 2019-2020 session and to the Municipal and County Government Committee for the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
